question: Is the focused structural/Testbox evidence sufficient to merge this release-workflow fix before the planned live exact-LTS parent/child/grandchild validation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct and preserves the immutable-SHA guard, but only a release owner can accept post-merge live proof for an automation path that cannot fully prove its canonical provenance through ordinary PR CI.

options.title: Merge and verify the live chain
options.body: Accept the bounded risk, merge the focused fix, and immediately run the documented exact-LTS validation with retained run IDs.

options.title: Require branch-run proof first
options.body: Delay merge until a branch-dispatched validation demonstrates canonical context propagation through the complete workflow chain.

recommendation.title: Merge and verify the live chain
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded risk, merge the focused fix, and immediately run the documented exact-LTS validation with retained run IDs.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows primary ownership of this release-validation workflow and its resolved-target contract.
